page.overview:
Who is Radovid II?

Radovid II, known as the Sailor, was the king of Redania. He was the son of King Vestibor and Queen Caitlyn of Kaedwen. He married Cirra of Cintra who bore him two sons: Radovid III and Vizimir I.

Under his rule Redania grew as a sea power. The king himself often went on long cruises, but his last ship never came back. Being the only Redanian king who disappeared without a trace, numerous legends sprung up with many waiting for his return during the reign of Radovid III and later Vridank.
